relationships.subject: kahweol
relationships.evidence_quote: Kahweol (80 µg/paw) induced peripheral antinociception against PGE2-induced hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: AM251
relationships.evidence_quote: The effect of the highest dose of kahweol (80 μg/paw) was fully reverted by the selective CB1 cannabinoid receptor antagonist AM251

relationships.subject: kahweol
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with kahweol induced a significant increase in AEA concentration

relationships.subject: anandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: kahweol induced peripheral antinociception via anandamide release and activation of CB1 cannabinoid receptors

relationships.subject: JZL184
relationships.evidence_quote: enhanced the peripheral antinociceptive effect of low-dose kahweol

key_findings: Intraplantar kahweol reversed PGE2-induced hyperalgesia in rats; the effect was blocked by CB1 antagonist AM251 but not CB2 antagonist AM630.
Kahweol raised paw anandamide but not 2-AG, OEA or PEA, and uptake/MAGL/FAAH inhibitors potentiated its effect.
